title: Multi-label and Multi-target Sampling of Machine Annotation for Computational Stance Detection

bias_targets.methodology: Comparing model predictions by feeding semantically identical but differently phrased task instructions to measure prompt sensitivity.

Evaluating model robustness by substituting the stance target with semantically relevant variant terms (e.g., 'atheism' vs. 'religion' or 'no belief in gods') and observing fluctuations in prediction accuracy.
Re-ordering the stance labels (e.g., Favor, Against, None) in the instruction prompt to measure how the position of the choices affects the model's predictions.
